identity.PMU: Whole child user events, including cold JIT and same wrapper; FEXServer outside target tree is excluded. Fresh launcher each sample, no AOT/object cache, OS page cache retained.
identity.time: CoreMark loop timer; other cases whole-child simpleperf elapsed including startup/JIT. No cross-workload score aggregation.

plan.task: post-push full benchmark anchor against fixed FEX
plan.selection: All samples; fixed five-launch medians, cyclic arm order. No optional stopping, threshold-driven followup, replacement or pooling with prior checkpoints.
plan.compile: Separate --decode-timing/byte-probe launches. Exclude only actual byte-parser interval. Include formation, all failed prefixes/retries, optimize, RA/emit, publication and current release window. FEX native-arena final destruction remains outside its old logical buffer-release probe.
plan.runtime: Fresh ordinary launch per sample, no AOT/object cache; OS page cache retained. CoreMark100000 CRCd340 loop timer >=10s; other cases whole-child simpleperf elapsed. PMU user cycles/instructions/branch-misses include cold JIT, no cross-workload average.
plan.compile_coremark_oracle: exit0 CRC4983; short-run official duration warning expected
plan.FEX_config: same prior Config.json, AVX off, no AOT/object cache; TSO retained
plan.x87_oracle: inherited exit-only benchmark; separate ext80 contracts do not turn this into full numerical/ISA validation

limitations: All8 fixed cases retain all48 original gates. Instructions/branch misses are diagnostics, not new gates.
Runtime/PMU metrics are separate five-observation medians; ratios use same-round-cohort FEX medians.
Five samples give no blanket significance/stability/all-application guarantee. CPU is not frequency locked.
CoreMark runtime100000 iterations; compile/work probe20 iterations. No cross-workload average.
func_tests retains native stdout/exit101 oracle and performance gates; x87 is exit-only, not numerical validation.
Native-owner versus FEX logical-working-buffer release is not an identical destruction endpoint.
Prior3 and supplementary7-per-arm results are historical only; identical code changes are not claimed.
